jess: quick thought  propose a tiny 'pinlet' helper on deploy-bot to attach a compact intent + optional pin + change-window and auto-draft a release note YAML preview so product/ops get context in one line

rory: sounds useful. example command?

jess: `/deploy pinlet --sig quickfix-embed --pin model=embed-2.4.1 --window '2026-03-25T15:00Z/1h' --auto-rollback 4%:10m --dry-run`

deploy-bot: preview pinch-3502500000 (dry-run): "sig: quickfix-embed | pin: embed-2.4.1 | window: 2026-03-25 15:00Z-16:00Z | auto-rollback:4%/10m"

rory: two asks: 1) `--pin-mode` append vs replace to preserve history; 2) idempotent behavior so retries merge instead of duplicate PRs

jess: agree. defaults: `--pin-mode=append`, `--idempotent=true`. ranges (e.g., `@^2`) require `--force-range` and show warning in dry-run

release-sheriff: canary metric hook available via `--canary=prometheus:svc/embed-canary` and bot can be told `--canary-metric=error_rate`

rory: UX: preview should include an expand button showing YAML snippet and actions [Create PR] [Cancel]. Create PR runs preflight hooks (lint, smoke) before creating draft PR

jess: will open short RFC with CLI flags list and sample YAML template. plan: beta flag for a week, then enable org-wide. assigning @release-sheriff to verify prometheus hook and @rory to review idempotency tests

rory: ack. LGTM :thumbsup:
